summary: HDFC Bank furnished a 6-K containing its August 19, 2026 disclosure that the Reserve Bank of India, by letter dated the same day, approved Life Insurance Corporation of India to acquire aggregate holding of up to 9.99% of HDFC Bank's paid-up share capital or voting rights. LIC beneficially held 4.11% as of August 14, 2026, implying headroom of roughly 5.9 percentage points. The RBI approval, issued on LIC's application, carries conditions requiring compliance with the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, the RBI Commercial Banks Acquisition and Holding of Shares Directions, 2025, FEMA, and SEBI regulations. No price, premium, or timetable is specified. Watch LIC's incremental open-market accumulation pace and any resulting free-float or index-weight effects.
